cc:Work.dc:description: Allowed-attention grids show all five by five pairs for an encoder and the lower triangle including the diagonal for a decoder. An encoder-decoder has a full four by four encoder grid, causal three by three decoder grid, and full three by four cross-attention grid. Padding masks are omitted for clarity.

font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52645a

g.text: Rows are queries, columns are keys. A dot means allowed; a cross means blocked.
